name: Pulse-Mimic Circuitry
description:
The Federation will reward anyone who participates in their campaign objective and delivers this to their item trader outside the Federation Navy Anchorage in <url=showinfo:5//30003788>Intaki</url>.

This circuitry is part of a device that attempts to mimic a Conquest activation pulse by through a lightspeed acceleration of Rogue Drone infestation interference.
